name: RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics
description: Access your LinkedIn career intelligence from Claude. RankedIn parses your LinkedIn data export and surfaces career scores, network metrics, peer benchmarks, AI insights, silent quitter detection, and career timeline data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://rankedin.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics provides these MCP tools: get_my_scores, get_network_summary, get_peer_comparison, get_connection_insights, get_improvement_tips, and get_career_timeline.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: RankedIn - Career Intelligence & Network Analytics is developed by Dharankar LLC (AttainMAX). It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
